thread:
sara: Quick follow-up from the Postmortem (RDS spike) — we need a short action plan to reduce paging noise and close the remediation loop. I created a tracking sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1REDWOOD-alert-curation (initial rows: redis, kvcache, api-latency). Please claim items you own by EOD Fri. :clipboard:

 tj: I'll take redis alert tuning. Plan: tighten threshold, add dedupe, and add a temporary backoff. ETA Fri COB. :thumbsup:

 leo: I'll own kvcache dedupe and the suppression window. Need to verify historical pattern to pick suppression window size — can someone drop the last 30 days of alert counts?

 maria: +1 on dedupe lib discussion. I'd also like a 2-tier threshold approach: `warning` (noise/visibility) vs `critical` (page). For example, warning triggers a slack thread and a ticket, critical pages. Also want auto-ticketing disabled for warning.

 tj: Draft rule example I'm proposing (will iterate):
```
alert: redis_high_ops
expr: sum(rate(redis_ops_total[5m])) by (shard) > 2000
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
  team: storage
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/REDIS-RUNBOOK
```
I'll add a `dedupe_key=shard` label to dedupe on shard-level.

 leo: Re: dedupe: we should prefer probabilistic dedupe for noisy metainfo, but start with exact key-based dedupe for 2 weeks. I'll add the existing aggregator query to the sheet.

 maria: On paging policy — propose: 1) warning -> no page, ticket + dashboard alert, 2) critical -> page, 3) if same alert fires >3 times within 30m, escalate to oncall lead. Thoughts?

 tj: Agree. Also suggest we add a canary rollout: enable new thresholds in us-west-2 for one day, monitor tokenized paging rate. If stable, roll global.

 oncall-bot: Action created: PM-4218 "Tune redis_high_ops alert" assigned to @tj, due 2026-04-02.

 sara: OK, action checklist before close: 1) owners claimed in sheet (done for redis/kvcache) 2) draft alert rules in PR (link to be posted) 3) runbook updated (leads: tj/leo) 4) canary plan & monitoring dashboard (maria) 5) follow-up review next Wed standup. If you haven't claimed within 48hrs we'll reassign. :spiral_calendar: 

 tj: I'll open the PR tonight and post the link in this thread.

 leo: I'll add the historical counts and the suppression test script to the sheet.

 maria: I'll create the canary dashboard and add a grafana panel comparing old vs new trigger counts.

 sara: Thanks all — will mark postmortem action status in the PM ticket and ping for the standup review. If any blockers ping me directly. :eyes:
